name: Onion and 'onto-' word fragments
description: Fires on 'onion'/'onions' and the 'onto-' string in 'ontology', as in 'Gotta love an ontology debate', plus 'man, holy' interjections.

name: Words with the 'in-fa/in-fo/in-flu' prefix
description: Activates on 'inf-' words like infamous, infographics, infrared, influencer, as in 'Check out Infamous and/or Infamous 2!'.

name: Efficiency and inefficiency vocabulary
description: Fires on tokens about efficiency, efficient and inefficient (often tied to 'German'), as in 'Because not everyone cares about efficiency'.

name: Getting to the point directly
description: Activates on 'point' and directional phrasing (come, proceed, towards), as in 'I like to get to the point'.

name: ENTJ personality type mentions
description: Fires on the MBTI label ENTJ and its plural (entj, entjs) in commentary about that type, as in 'I don't hate ENTJs though'.

name: Giving someone or something a chance
description: Activates on 'give/giving X a chance/shot/credit' constructions (give, giving, gotta, chance), as in 'Gotta give the other team a chance'.

name: Procrastination as a topic
description: Fires on the word procrastination and its inflections (procrastinating, procrastinate, master), as in 'Procrastination. Sad and depressive procrastination'.

name: Calling something a rollercoaster
description: Activates on the metaphor 'rollercoaster' (roller, coaster, emotional) with emphatic interjections, as in 'That was a goddamn rollercoaster'.

name: The noun and verb 'influence'
description: Fires on 'influence' across senses (influence, friends, people), as in 'How to win friends and influence people' and 'American influence?'.

name: Words and phrases with 'in-' fragments
description: Activates on the 'in' string in tokens like incel, inbreeding and 'in game editor', as in 'break out the in game editor'.
